name: THE MESSAGE BOY
note: Doc 07 #5. 'Everywhere. Runs notes for a penny. Knows more than anyone. Is nine.' Placed on Main Street, between the Company and the Clarion, the street being the part of 'everywhere' that is built (errata 110). A boy: his stature is a nine-year-old's, set when the art is cut. Errata 193 (Tyler, 2026-11-08): moved off Main Street to the Lane, between the photographer's door and Madame Ozymandia's tent, clear of both and of every door.
greetsWithBarkNote: As the card sharp (Tyler, 2026-10-31): TALK TO opens with his bark for the current reputation. Doc 07 writes no root line for him; this stages his own barks, it adds none.
walkToNote: Errata 193: beside him at his own depth, from his right, in front of the tent's left side and clear of its flap's approach point.

barks.R_SWINDLED: I could've told you about Mr. Vessel. Penny.
barks.R_RACCOON: Everybody knows about the raccoon. That one's free.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Three men paid me to find out where you're staying.

barks.R_DEAD: You're in the paper. You're dead in the paper. Penny?
